name: phonebox-website-tests
description: Root-level test harness. tests/website/ covers website/js/ (the plain-ES-module dashboard twin of app/src/); tests/contracts/ covers claims that belong to no single sub-project, like the BLE uuids shared by the CircuitPython firmware and the app. Not a build target -- see firebase.json's hosting.public: 'website' for why the website suites can't live under website/ itself.

scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project phonebox-d14b7 "npm --prefix app run test:rules"
